lie_leader.prompt: r_c asks where you were last night. The truth would get you in trouble.
lie_leader.between: You tell r_c part of it. It isn't a lie, exactly.
lie_leader.resist: You tell r_c the truth. {PRONOUN/r_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/r_c/look/looks} at you for a long moment, then {VERB/r_c/nod/nods}.

gathering_fight.prompt: At the Gathering, a cat from o_c_n sneers at c_n, and at you. Your claws itch.
gathering_fight.between: You snap back sharp enough to make the o_c_n cat flinch, but your claws stay sheathed.
gathering_fight.resist: You turn your back on the o_c_n cat. The truce holds, and a few of your Clanmates notice.

pass_secrets.prompt: A cat from o_c_n finds you alone near the border. They want to know where c_n's patrols go, and they'll make it worth your while.
pass_secrets.between: You tell the o_c_n cat a patrol route that c_n hasn't used in moons, and leave before they can ask more.
pass_secrets.resist: You tell the o_c_n cat to go back to their own territory, and you don't look back.

neglect_kit.prompt: You hear a kit crying near the border. It smells of o_c_n.
options: Tell your patrol and let them decide
Carry it to its Clan's border
neglect_kit.between: You tell your patrol about the kit. What happens next isn't up to you.
neglect_kit.resist: You carry the kit to the o_c_n border and call until one of their warriors comes for it.

hunt_border.prompt: Hunger gnaws at you. The pile is bare, and o_c_n's border is close.
options: Take one bite, then turn back
hunt_border.between: You slip across, snatch one mouse, and are back on your own side before you've finished it.
hunt_border.resist: You turn away from the border. Your belly aches all the way home.

hide_sign.prompt: StarClan sends you a sign, and you don't like what it means.
options: Tell r_c only part of it
hide_sign.between: You tell r_c some of what StarClan showed you, and keep the worst of it back.
hide_sign.resist: You tell r_c everything StarClan showed you, even the part you wish you hadn't seen.

bend_sign.prompt: The sign is clear, but r_c won't like it, and neither do you.
options: Tell r_c it means something else
Tell r_c what it really means
bend_sign.between: You tell r_c the sign isn't clear yet. It is.
bend_sign.resist: You tell r_c exactly what the sign means, and watch {PRONOUN/r_c/object} take it in.

carry_messages.prompt: A cat from o_c_n asks you to carry a message to someone in c_n.
carry_messages.between: You carry the message, and tell r_c about it first.
carry_messages.resist: You tell the o_c_n cat that c_n's business goes through c_n's leader.

hide_news.prompt: You hear something r_c should know. It would mean trouble for a cat you care about.
options: Tell r_c in a few days
hide_news.between: You wait a few days before telling r_c. It's not quite keeping it from {PRONOUN/r_c/object}.
hide_news.resist: You tell r_c right away, even though it hurts to.

ignore_sign.prompt: r_c brings you a sign from StarClan. It asks something of you that you don't want to give.
options: Do only part of what it asks
ignore_sign.between: You do part of what the sign asks, and leave the rest undone.
ignore_sign.resist: You thank r_c, and do what StarClan asks, even though you'd rather not.

secret_meeting.prompt: o_c_n's leader sends word: meet at the border tonight, alone.
options: Go alone, and tell no one
secret_meeting.between: You go to the border, but you bring your deputy. Whatever o_c_n's leader wanted, they don't say it in front of a witness.
secret_meeting.resist: You send word back: c_n's leader doesn't meet anyone in secret.

claim_land.prompt: The o_c_n border has always felt too close to c_n's camp. A strip of their land would make the Clan stronger.
options: Lead a patrol and claim it
Raise it at the next Gathering
Leave the border where it is
claim_land.between: You'll raise the border at the next Gathering, where every Clan can hear it.
claim_land.resist: You leave the border where it is. It isn't yours to move.

healer_mate.prompt: r_c wants to be your mate. A healer isn't supposed to take a mate.
options: Take r_c as your mate in secret
healer_mate.take_mate: You and r_c are mates now. r_c is a healer, so no one can know.

healer_kits.prompt_healer: Your kits are born. Healers aren't supposed to have kits.
healer_kits.prompt_mate: Your kits are born. Their other parent is r_c, a healer.
options: Give them to a queen to raise
healer_kits.raise: You curl around your newborn kits. Whatever the Clan says, they're yours.

witness.prompt: You saw m_c [act]. What do you do?
options_leader: Tell the deputy and the senior warriors
options_as_leader: Deal with it at the full moon
witness.listen: You tell m_c you know that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} [act]. m_c's ears flatten. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/promise/promises} it won't happen again.
witness.bristle: You tell m_c you know that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} [act]. m_c tells you to mind your own business.

omen.prompt: StarClan shows you something about m_c. They're troubled by {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.

challenge_call.prompt: c_n no longer trusts m_c, and neither do you. The warrior code lets a Clan challenge a leader who has lost its trust.

challenge_vote.prompt: r_c has called for a challenge against m_c. The Clan votes.
